name: Multi-Step Forms for Contact Form 7
author: azmarket

sections.description:
• Split any Contact Form 7 form into steps (tabs) — add, rename, reorder.
  • Per-step validation: Next only moves on when the current step is valid; scrolls to and focuses the first error.
  • Progress indicator: progress bar, numbered steps (1 → 2 → 3) or current step name.
  • 4 style presets — Minimal, Modern, Corporate, Rounded — plus primary/button colors, spacing and border radius. No CSS needed.
  • Mobile-first: scrolls to the top of the form on each step, keeps the Next button above the on-screen keyboard, supports the browser Back button, shows a loading state and prevents double submits.

Pro version adds an Arrow tabs indicator, transition effects between steps, custom step names, button icons and button hover colors.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Contact Form 7.
  2. Install and activate Multi-Step Forms for Contact Form 7.
  3. Edit a contact form, switch multi-step ON in the Form tab and split the fields into steps.
  4. Adjust the look and behavior in the Multi-step tab.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • New: per-step Back / Next / Submit button labels.
  • New: Auto scroll to top and Return to first step after submit options.
  • New: always-visible remove (×) button on step tabs.
  • New: plugin now declares Contact Form 7 as a required plugin.
  • Improved: settings screen layout (button color groups, toggle switches).
  • Fix: step tabs and step options no longer misalign with some admin themes.
  • Changed: plugin renamed to “Multi-Step Forms for Contact Form 7” (WordPress.org trademark rules).
  • Fix: Plugin Check issues (text domain, translator comments, prefixed variables and class names).

1.1.0

  • New: per-step validation with scroll and focus to the first error.
  • New: progress indicator styles (bar, numbered steps, step name).
  • New: Minimal, Modern, Corporate and Rounded style presets with basic color, spacing and radius options.
  • New: mobile improvements — keyboard-aware Next button, browser Back support, submit loading state, double-submit protection.
  • Fix: plugin styles no longer affect other forms on the site.
  • Fix: backslashes and the letters “rn” were removed from saved step content.

1.0.2

  • UX/UI improvements and CSS fixes.
